definition: A gene encoding a small GTPase involved in membrane-associated regulated exocytosis and synaptic vesicle trafficking; heterozygous pathogenic variants in RAB3A (such as c.247C>T, p.Arg83Trp) cause spinocerebellar ataxia 52 (SCA52), an autosomal-dominant progressive cerebellar ataxia characterized by cerebellar atrophy and variable neurodevelopmental or spastic features.

source.title: An R83W mutation in Rab3A causes autosomal-dominant cerebellar ataxia
source.quote: In this study, we identified the c.247C > T p.(Arg83Trp) variant in RAB3A, encoding a small GTPase involved in membrane-associated regulated exocytosis, in two families with cerebellar ataxia.
